requirements.title: AI host relationship and concentration total
requirements.summary: The AI BS requires exactly one concentration with six distinct courses (6/3 units). This is the total including fixed requirements and local choices, not an extra elective block. The host degree remains separately audited.

requirements.title: Concentration-related MQP and advising
requirements.summary: The AI MQP is 3/3 units and applies AI knowledge and techniques within the selected concentration. A sole adviser must be AI core/collaborative faculty within that discipline; otherwise an AI core/collaborative faculty member and a faculty member with disciplinary knowledge co-advise. This is the host MQP applied to the concentration, not a second additional MQP.

requirements.title: Science overlap and degree-level advanced floor
requirements.summary: If a course overlaps the natural/engineering-science requirement and concentration or disciplinary electives, add other BS-AI distribution courses to retain ten program units. The host degree’s 4/3-unit floor at 4000 level or above can be met across core, concentration and other distribution work; it is not an extra four-course local concentration minimum.

requirements.title: Concentration declaration and scope
requirements.summary: A concentration requires two integrated-study units and a related MQP. Plan with the adviser and apply to the program review committee by its deadlines; concentration requirements cannot prevent completion of the major.

requirements.title: Additional-designation overlap ceiling
requirements.summary: Concentrations/minors may overlap another additional designation by at most one unit. No credit-bearing activity may be triple-counted across degree requirements or designations.

requirements.title: Credit-bearing completion
requirements.summary: A/B/C are undergraduate course grades that earn credit; NR does not. IQP/MQP/HUA require an overall completion evaluation; project SP is temporary and must be replaced by a permanent grade.

requirements.title: No institutional undergraduate GPA
requirements.summary: WPI does not maintain an undergraduate cumulative GPA. A numerical equivalent may be requested for external use; no GPA graduation threshold is inferred.

requirements.title: Graduate-course use and conversion
requirements.summary: Graduate enrollment ordinarily does not require graduate admission; Business School courses require admission to a dual BS/MS program. The published conversion is one graduate credit to 1/6 undergraduate unit, processed by the Registrar.

notes: This is the exact named concentration within the AI major, not a separate BS award. Only local concentration requirements and applicable policies are audited; the host degree remains separately represented.

Six distinct courses is the total including fixed requirements and chosen bins, not six additional electives. Do not add total and component choice descriptors. Native WPI units are retained, with the published graduate conversion stated separately.

Explicitly open subject/level or approval routes remain rules, not invented exhaustive course lists. Course descriptions, recommended background and individual prerequisites remain separate metadata gaps.
